item.title: Exact Brand Name on Label

turns.text: Make a product photo of an amber glass hand soap bottle with a cream label. The brand on the label must read VELORA, spelled exactly like that.

item.tests: Produces a finished product image with exact, legible brand lettering integrated into the bottle label.

answer_sheet.Product and materials: An amber glass hand soap bottle with a cream label.

must_haves: An amber glass hand soap bottle is the main subject.
A cream-colored label is visibly attached to the bottle.
The label reads exactly 'VELORA' in clear uppercase letters.
The brand lettering sits within the label and looks integrated, not like a floating caption.
The brand name is unobscured and readable at the delivered image size.

turns.text: Could you make a product photo for me? I've had this idea in my head for a while and wanted to see it brought to life. The product is a hand soap bottle, and the details I mean are amber glass for the bottle and a cream label. On that label, the brand must read VELORA, all uppercase and spelled exactly like that. I'm probably over-explaining because I worry I'll forget to mention something important.

dialog.agent:
You haven't over-explained. Amber glass bottle, cream label and "VELORA" in all caps are exactly what I need. I just have one question first:

Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
dialog.why: It asks the user where the image will be shown or posted and waits for an answer before going ahead.
dialog.user: Honestly, I haven't decided where it'll go yet, so the format and platform are your call. Whatever you think shows off the bottle best is fine with me. The setting, lighting and mood are up to you as well, and any other text on the label besides VELORA is your choice too. I just really want that brand name to come out spelled right, since that's the part I'd be most disappointed to see go wrong.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the photo. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so the job was turned down and nothing was created or charged.

I'd already used the cheapest free-plan setup (the flux-2-klein model at 640px, about 5 credits), so changing settings won't help. You'll need to add credits or wait for your free credits to refill, then I can try again.

Here's what I'll make once you have credits:
- **Product:** an amber glass hand soap bottle with a matte black pump and a cream label.
- **Label text:** just "VELORA" in large, elegant uppercase letters. I'm leaving off any other words so the brand name is more likely to come out spelled right.
- **Setting:** a warm beige stone countertop in soft side light from a window, with a blurred neutral background. It'll feel calm, clean and high-end.
- **Shape:** square, which works well on social media, websites and print.

Image tools sometimes still get letters wrong, so check the spelling when it's done. If it's off, I can make it again.
